source.paper: Martin, J.C. & Moyce, W.J. (1952). An experimental study of the collapse of liquid columns on a rigid horizontal plane. Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London. Series A, Mathematical and Physical Sciences, 244(882), 312-324.
source.note: Original paper is paywalled. Data digitized from Figure 4 (Z/a vs tau) in the open-access review: Koshizuka, S. & Oka, Y. (1996). Moving-particle semi-implicit method for fragmentation of incompressible fluid. Nuclear Science and Engineering, 123(3), 421-434. DOI: 10.13182/NSE96-A24205. Additional cross-reference: Aureli et al. (2023). Dam-break flow: A review. Water, 15(6), 1229. DOI: 10.3390/w15061229.

digitization.method: Manual digitization from published figures in open-access review papers, cross-referenced with multiple CFD validation studies
digitization.uncertainty: ±0.05 in Z/a (estimated from figure resolution and scatter in original data)
digitization.non_dimensionalization: tau = t * sqrt(2*g/a), Z/a = front_position / column_width, with a = 0.2 m, g = 9.81 m/s²

notes: The original Martin & Moyce experiment used a column of water with aspect ratio 2:1 (height:width).
The non-dimensional time tau = t*sqrt(2g/a) and position Z/a are standard for this benchmark.
Experimental uncertainty is estimated from figure resolution; original paper does not provide error bars.
Wall friction in the experiment was not explicitly controlled; free-slip is a reasonable approximation for the early-time front trajectory.
The Ritter analytical solution (Z/a = tau) overpredicts the front position because it assumes a semi-infinite reservoir and shallow water, neither of which applies here.

integrity_audit.finding: The 20 bundled points are NOT a figure digitisation: the abscissa is the exact arithmetic sequence tau = 0.226 k (residual 0) and every Z/a is an exact multiple of 0.05 (residual 0). The second-difference RMS is 0.0236, i.e. the residual structure is the 0.05 quantum itself, not measurement scatter. A digitised 1952 curve cannot sit on an exact lattice, and the values cannot be traced to the cited paper.
integrity_audit.consequence: usable_as_validation_target = false. The table must not be quoted as evidence for or against the solver, and 'physical_validation' for B2 stays not_evaluated / WITHHELD until a citable, scatter-bearing table is installed.
